ux_dom.profiling.doc: Internal / maintainer profiling helpers (not a day-1 user API).

cprofile_to_speedscope.doc: Minimal speedscope "sampled" profile from cProfile stats.

measure_latency.doc: Wall-clock latency distribution for a zero-arg callable.
measure_latency.signature: (fn: Callable[[], Any], *, name: str='op', rounds: int=100, warmup: int=10) -> LatencyReport

profile_cprofile.doc: Run ``fn`` under cProfile; return Stats + text dump.
profile_cprofile.signature: (fn: Callable[[], Any], *, name: str='op', rounds: int=50) -> tuple[pstats.Stats, str]

run_suite.doc: Run latency + cProfile + speedscope for a list of (name, fn).
run_suite.signature: (benches: Sequence[tuple[str, Callable[[], Any]]], *, out_dir: Path, title: str, rounds: int=80, warmup: int=8, profile_rounds: int=40) -> dict[str, Any]

write_html_report.signature: (path: Path, *, title: str, latencies: Sequence[LatencyReport], pstats_text: str='', notes: str='') -> Path
